S1 BLOCKING — Cross-kind targeting disposition overlooks source visibility restrictions.
Violated invariant/authority: O4 of owning bead eshyra-o9bd.19.3.1 explicitly requires the non-creature projected-target sweep to repair or source-disposition dropped printed qualifiers; opus:F-35 / registry targeting-qualifiers requires complete targeting qualifiers. ADR 0020 preserves source fidelity and requires truthful disposition of existing defects.
Location: docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json:436 claims the sweep found no dropped qualifier. Counterexamples are packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:317-322 (Iron Flask) and packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/mechanicsProjections.ts:5603-5606 (Sculpt Spells), and their emitted records.
Concrete scenarios: Iron Flask prints “targeting a creature that you can see within 60 feet” (vendored SRD p.228), but its mechanics target/trigger/range and containment entry preserve plane and range only, with no sight requirement. An unseen extraplanar creature 30 feet away satisfies the projected restrictions although the source forbids targeting it. Sculpt Spells prints “other creatures that you can see” (p.54), but its autoSucceedSave projection has targets: chosen-creatures and no visibility qualifier anywhere in mechanics; selecting an unseen ally affected by an evocation spell likewise satisfies the projection despite the source restriction. This is a capture/projection/disposition defect; no claim that a deterministic capability currently executes either complete procedure is needed or made.
Sibling analysis: queried every non-creature target/targets field and then every such record with “can see”/mutual-sight source wording. Nine records in the visibility cohort; precisely Sculpt Spells and Iron Flask omit sight across their projections. Eyes of Charming retains requiresMutualSight; Gem of Brightness, Ring of the Ram, Robe of Scintillating Colors, Rod of Lordly Might, Rope of Entanglement and Wand of Paralysis retain sight in target/activation fields, with range in linked payloads where applicable. Varied visible/unseen targets while holding range and creature eligibility constant. Other target restrictions may legitimately live in linked fields (e.g. oil size-dependent cost) rather than the target string.
Required closure: repair both omitted visibility predicates in their compiler inputs and regenerate, inspect the same non-creature target population for equivalent losses, and correct F-35 reasoning. If a projection is deliberately partial, it needs an explicit source-backed disposition/limit rather than the current false no-loss assertion. Add source-backed regression evidence for both real clauses, preferably one generalized predicate over the reviewed visibility cohort; exact source cases must retain their claims under the importer protocol. Owner: 19.3.1. Repair is MATERIAL (source-semantic projections/disposition change); fresh full review required at the successor head.
